criteria: Conditional clearance is supported only when affected tubes are scheduled for retubing and recommended gasket replacement is recorded before return to service.

assessments.criterion: Tube-wall measurements below the minimum allowable value must be listed and corrected before return to service.
assessments.requiredAction: Retube the affected tubes in rows 12–15.

assessments.criterion: Localised pitting must be recorded as an inspection finding and included in the approval decision.
assessments.requiredAction: Retain the pitting measurement and location in the approval record.

assessments.criterion: Recommended gasket replacement must be recorded before return to service.
assessments.requiredAction: Record and complete the recommended channel-head gasket replacement.

assessments.criterion: The supplied record must establish the approval status or leave the decision for human review.
assessments.requiredAction: Obtain approval authority disposition; do not claim final approval from this report alone.

recommendation: Conditional clearance pending retubing of the affected tubes and recording the recommended gasket replacement. Final approval authority disposition is still required.

missingInformation.note: No approving authority or final approval status is stated in the supplied inspection report.
